column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the bytes.
# v0.1.0 (c18a361) is the only published build: there is no dev pre-release and no predecessor
# repo. It pinned core c480d8a. Every core source its reader compiles holds the same bytes at
# c480d8a and at the current pin, apart from ads/ads_mode.h, which core has since removed and
# the oracle carries as a copy. Comparison 1 is not empty by construction: the frozen reader is
# 02b6f3e's src/core/config.cpp, which differs from v0.1.0's (e5fb487 retired the ADS mode).
